situations.headline: Arovella doses first ALA-101 patient imminently after batch release and site activation
Arovella issues routine 2026 AGM notice; no new clinical data

changelog.entry: stage-2 assessment: Arovella doses first ALA-101 patient imminently after batch release and site activation (interest 6, risk 7)
stage-2 assessment: Arovella issues routine 2026 AGM notice; no new clinical data (interest 2, risk 7)

thesis.text: Arovella is a pre-revenue, single-lead-asset clinical biotech whose value hinges on Phase 1 proof-of-concept for ALA-101, an allogeneic iNKT/CAR19 cell therapy; the recent batch release and site activation de-risk the manufacturing step but the company remains fully exposed to binary clinical readouts, funding needs, and regulatory risk, warranting close monitoring of dosing and interim data announcements rather than a position based on this milestone alone.
